title: Fire station bills tied to Methodist church rezoning
summary: The Council passed Bill 94 on November 25, rezoning about 3.26 acres in Lahaina for Lahaina United Methodist Church. The church, its school and other buildings were destroyed in the August 2023 wildfires, and the zoning change will help it rebuild. A committee earlier voted nine to zero to recommend the bill, changing the land from R2 Residential to P1 Public/Quasi-Public, and later removed the zoning conditions.
